name: 15212 · Pittsburgh, PA
findings: ZIP 15212 (Pittsburgh) has 1,724 nonprofit organizations. 185 of them (11%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 164 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (15% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 15212 (Pittsburgh) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
60% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 15212 (Pittsburgh) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.7 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 164 organizations here; 93% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
